observations.inactive_complete_simd_groups: phase and trigger state remain bit-identical until active again, except explicit source reset events
observations.inactive_lanes_in_active_groups: advance with the complete four-lane group; visible channel count does not round up

required_coverage: actual default bank and shared explicit f32 synthetic banks
position 0 and 1 and a fractional position between waves
signed position CV and clamp boundaries
exponential FM and positive-frequency linear FM
VCO hard sync including minBLEP startup and tails; soft sync directions
LFO clock connection, measurement, rejection, disconnection and reconnection
LFO reset thresholds, offset, invert and simultaneous flags
mono broadcast, short poly zero fill, disconnected ports, widths 1 4 5 16
whole SIMD group freeze and reactivation; active-group hidden lanes
parameter adoption preserving all oscillator, sync, trigger and clock state
empty and invalid banks, loading freeze, atomic bank replacement, wave-length rebuild
explicit source onReset lifecycle and fresh-instance determinism
rust_only_safe_functional_requirements: VCO linear FM crossing through zero remains finite, wraps phase in both directions and selects bandlimit using absolute frequency
VCO exact zero frequency remains finite and holds phase while sync remains usable
negative-to-positive FM transitions preserve phase continuity except explicit hard sync
wave-length changes atomically rebuild the prepared bank before publication
nonfinite/out-of-range host input handling and host public parameter validation
serialization, graph replacement/adoption, bypass and reset policies through the real host API
excluded_source_undefined_behavior: Negative/zero VCO frequency reaches log2 and float-to-size_t conversion of NaN/infinity. Never execute or claim fidelity for that source path.
rationale: 2 mV plus 10 ppm is the existing driven DSP comparison budget, far below a 10 V nominal signal span, while permitting FFT/libm rounding across the independent implementation. Exact widths and event/trigger metadata prevent an amplitude tolerance from hiding lifecycle or routing errors. No startup skip, phase alignment, RMS substitute or per-case relaxation is allowed.
